'''Daz's Tavern''' was located in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Dalia (township)|Dalia]] on [[Dalicron-4]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] largest settlement. It was the social center of the small village, a [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] structure that served both [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and drinks. By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Daz (Dalicron-4)|Daz]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], owned and operated the tavern. [[Linia]], his daughter, also worked there. [[Anna]] and [[Jani]] both served as cooks at the eatery. [[Veeter]], a depressed [[Squib/Legends|Squib]], was a regular customer at the tavern, constantly trying to dampen his sorrow of being stranded on the planet by drinking.
